description: This file defines an enumeration 'TransactionalStatus' representing various states and errors in transaction status management within Orleans Transactions. It also provides extension methods to interpret these statuses, including determining if a transaction definitely aborted and converting statuses to user-facing exceptions.

classes.name: TransactionalStatusExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for the TransactionalStatus enum, including logic to determine if a transaction has definitely aborted and to convert transaction statuses into specific exceptions for diagnostics and user messages.

methods.name: DefinitelyAborted
methods.description: Returns true if the transactional status indicates that the transaction has definitely aborted.

methods.name: ConvertToUserException
methods.description: Converts a TransactionalStatus into its corresponding OrleansTransactionException, incorporating transaction ID and underlying exception for diagnostics and user feedback.
